Behind the music

The story

A producer whochose to return.

The sound always returns.

The process

Every track beginswith a single idea.

00:03

Searching for the first idea.

Before the arrangement, there is only silence and a direction.

2005

Born in Kryvyi Rih, Ukraine.

Before the music, before the name and before the first release, there was simply a kid growing up in an industrial city.

2022

Everything started with a simple beat.

A friend asked for an instrumental with nothing more than a kick and a bass. It was the first time FL Studio was opened — and the beginning of something that would return again and again.

Finding a sound

Phonk became a way to express what words could not.

It could feel calm and distant, emotional and melancholic, or aggressive and motivating. The contrast made the genre feel limitless.

REBIRTH

The first real moment

One evening. One unusual idea. One finished track.

No strategy.

No expectations.

Just music.

SILENCE

The interruption

Then the music became quiet.

Projects were started and abandoned. Motivation disappeared near the finish line. Around ten ideas were left behind, and only three survived.

There were moments when starting again under a different name felt easier.

But the channel had already become a part of me.

RETURN

Now

The reason to return was always there.

Not to chase artificial numbers. Not to follow every trend. But to return to something that once brought real excitement, pride and the feeling of creating something meaningful.

The story was never finished.

It was only waiting to continue.

Evelasting

The soundalways returns.

This isn’t the end of the story.

It’s the return.

The next chapter

From Kryvyi Rih

To the world.

Continue the story through sound.
